source.policy: Lucide is the default system icon source for generic UI actions and navigation. Product or brand symbols are not forced into Lucide.
reason: straightforward React and React Native consumption

visualLanguage.opticalRule: Scale the icon silhouette to the assigned visual-size token; do not independently thin or thicken strokes per component.
visualLanguage.alignmentRule: Align by optical center inside the component slot, not by arbitrary SVG bounding-box nudges.

tokens.rule: Only stable visual sizes are tokenized. Source library, stroke style, cap/join, accessible naming and custom-icon admission remain contract rules rather than design tokens.

colorPolicy.rule: Icons consume existing Semantic Color roles. Do not create a parallel icon color palette.

examples.statusOnNeutralSurface: color.status.* when the actual pairing passes contrast

allowedWhen: no semantically correct Lucide icon exists
brand or product identity requires a proprietary symbol
domain concept cannot be represented without misleading reuse
mustMatch: 24x24 source grid or equivalent optical grid
round linecap and linejoin where applicable
prohibited: mixing filled and outline generic UI icons without an explicit exception
using custom icons only to look more decorative
shrinking the interactive hit target to the visible icon

exceptions: Brand logos and partner marks preserve their identity geometry and may be filled.
Checkbox, radio, switch and progress marks are component primitives, not general-purpose system icons.
Illustrations and empty-state artwork are not governed by the system icon source rule.
